name: Tempo push-up
note: Lower for 3 seconds, then press away.

name: Pike push-up
note: Drive the crown of your head toward the floor.

name: Diamond push-up
note: Keep elbows close and hips level.

name: Inchworm
note: Walk the hands out to a strong plank and return.

name: Plank shoulder tap
note: Keep your hips still as each hand lifts.

name: Decline push-up
note: Keep a straight line from heels to head.

name: Bodyweight squat
note: Sit between your heels and stand tall.

name: Reverse lunge
note: Step back softly and drive through the front foot.

name: Glute bridge
note: Pause at the top without arching your back.

name: Split squat
note: Drop straight down with a tall torso.

name: Single-leg glute bridge
note: Keep the pelvis level as you lift.

name: Jump squat
note: Land quietly and reset your balance.

name: Skater squat
note: Control the descent on one leg.

name: Lateral lunge
note: Sit into one hip while the other leg stays long.

name: Single-leg calf raise
note: Use a full range and pause at the top.

name: Forearm plank
note: Brace as if preparing for a punch.

name: Dead bug
note: Keep the low back gently pressed down.

name: Bird dog
note: Reach long without rotating your hips.

name: Hollow body hold
note: Shorten the lever if your back lifts.

name: Side plank
note: Press the floor away and keep hips stacked.

name: V-up
note: Reach hands and feet together with control.

name: Bear crawl
note: Keep knees low and take small steps.

name: Mountain climber
note: Keep shoulders stacked over wrists.

name: Squat thrust
note: Step or jump back without dropping the hips.

name: Burpee
note: Move smoothly and land quietly.

name: Dumbbell floor press
note: Pause the upper arms lightly on the floor.

name: One-arm dumbbell row
note: Pull your elbow toward your back pocket.

name: Seated dumbbell press
note: Keep ribs stacked and press straight up.

name: Arnold press
note: Rotate smoothly without leaning back.

name: Renegade row
note: Widen your feet and keep hips square.

name: Dumbbell floor fly
note: Use a soft elbow and stop gently at the floor.

name: Goblet squat
note: Keep the weight close to your chest.

name: Dumbbell Romanian deadlift
note: Push the hips back with a long spine.

name: Dumbbell reverse lunge
note: Keep most of your weight over the front leg.

name: Dumbbell step-up
note: Drive through the working foot without bouncing.

name: Dumbbell thruster
note: Use leg drive to send the weights overhead.

name: Dumbbell snatch
note: Keep the weight close and finish tall.

name: Suitcase march
note: Resist leaning toward the weight.

name: Dumbbell dead bug
note: Hold one weight over the chest as limbs extend.

name: Chest press
note: Set the handles at mid-chest and press evenly.

name: Lat pulldown
note: Pull elbows down without swinging.

name: Seated cable row
note: Stay tall and finish with elbows behind you.

name: Cable face pull
note: Finish with hands beside your temples.

name: Barbell bench press
note: Keep feet planted and shoulder blades set.

name: Assisted pull-up
note: Lead with the chest and lower fully.

name: Barbell bent-over row
note: Hold a strong hinge and pull toward the ribs.

name: Barbell back squat
note: Brace before each rep and track knees over toes.

name: Leg press
note: Lower only as far as your pelvis stays planted.

name: Seated leg curl
note: Curl smoothly and control the return.

name: Cable pull-through
note: Hinge back, then squeeze the glutes through.

name: Barbell deadlift
note: Push the floor away and keep the bar close.

name: Sled push
note: Use short, powerful steps with a rigid trunk.

name: Rowing machine sprint
note: Drive with the legs before finishing with the arms.

name: Cable woodchop
note: Rotate through the upper back, not the knees.

name: Pallof press
note: Press straight out without letting the cable rotate you.

name: Hanging knee raise
note: Curl the pelvis up without swinging.
